# Posting cadence

**How often do we post?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C14, C26


## About one reel a day
<a id="daily"></a>

Daily posting, with occasional doubles, at fixed time slots.

**Looks like:** Ten reels in ten days at 10–11:30 or 17:30–19:30 IST. Series episodes and timely reels keep the feed fresh.

**Good at:** volume of learning; algorithm presence; riding news cycles

**Weak at:** burnout; quality per reel drops without a team

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, story · niches all · goals reach, speed · effort high

**How:** Batch-film, keep templates, and keep a bank of finished reels.

**Backed by:** [Rahul: ~1 reel a day, two time slots](../topics/growth.md#growth-rahul-cadence), [Fast growers: no missed days, one line](../topics/growth.md#growth-tiktok-daily-ig-skip), [Promise hook: daily habit, three payoffs](../topics/hooks.md#l11-promise-hook), [Series get the best view-to-follower ratio](../topics/growth.md#growth-series-view-to-follower), [You compete with the whole feed](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-compete-with-feed) · sources R1, L08

## Three a week, pillar system
<a id="three-a-week-pillars"></a>

At least 3 expert posts a week: 3–5 formats, each 3–4 times a month (12–16 posts), reviewed monthly.

**Looks like:** Monday a tutorial, Wednesday a take, Friday a carousel, every week. At month end you compare pillars and swap the weakest after two bad months.

**Good at:** sustainable; clean A/B by format; quality per post

**Weak at:** slower learning than daily; needs monthly review

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel · niches all · goals trust, follows · effort medium

**How:** A pillar calendar with a format label on each slot. About an hour of review a month.

**Backed by:** [Expert content: 3 a week minimum](../topics/growth.md#growth-expert-cadence), [Pillar system: 3–5 formats × 3–4 a month](../topics/growth.md#growth-pillar-system), [Growth timelines and 1% maths (claims)](../topics/growth.md#growth-one-percent-better), [Accordion: volume to learn, then effort](../topics/growth.md#growth-accordion-method), [Monthly top-10% review](../topics/growth.md#growth-top-10-percent-review) · sources L07

## Accordion: volume first, then effort
<a id="accordion"></a>

Post a lot early to learn what the audience calls quality, then fewer, bigger pieces.

**Looks like:** Months 1–3: rough, 'just trimmed' reels most days. Later: three highly produced pieces a week that carry what the volume phase taught.

**Good at:** fast learning; less perfectionism early; matches growth stage

**Weak at:** early posts look rough; needs honest review to know when to switch

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-long · niches all · goals speed, trust · effort medium

**How:** Set a date or follower milestone to compress.

**Backed by:** [Accordion: volume to learn, then effort](../topics/growth.md#growth-accordion-method), [Perfect is the enemy of posted](../topics/growth.md#growth-perfect-enemy-of-posted), [Voice cadence as pattern interrupt](../topics/sound.md#sound-voice-cadence-interrupt), [Pillar system: 3–5 formats × 3–4 a month](../topics/growth.md#growth-pillar-system), [Train a cut rhythm, then break it](../topics/editing.md#edit-trained-rhythm-break) · sources L05

## Sustainable baseline and a bank
<a id="baseline-plus-bank"></a>

A rate you can always hit, backed by a bank of 14–15 ready videos and a fixed daily filming hour.

**Looks like:** A promise like 3 shorts a week that never slips, because two weeks of reels are already edited. Filming happens in one protected hour.

**Good at:** consistency; less stress; covers bad weeks

**Weak at:** the bank can go stale on timely topics; needs a big first batch

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals follows, speed · effort medium

**How:** Keep evergreen reels in a 'bank' folder and timely reels separate.

**Backed by:** [Perfect is the enemy of posted](../topics/growth.md#growth-perfect-enemy-of-posted), [Fast growers: no missed days, one line](../topics/growth.md#growth-tiktok-daily-ig-skip), [Sacred hour at your best energy](../topics/filming.md#film-sacred-hour), [Rahul: ~1 reel a day, two time slots](../topics/growth.md#growth-rahul-cadence), [Promise hook: daily habit, three payoffs](../topics/hooks.md#l11-promise-hook) · sources L08, L05

## Mixing
An accordion can start daily and settle into a pillar system. A bank makes any cadence steadier.

## Rule of thumb
Learning fast: daily or accordion. Brand quality: three a week. Unpredictable weeks: baseline plus bank.
